parameters.name: ResourceCategoryId
parameters.description: The resource category ID. Filters the computation results by the specified resource category. If this parameter is not specified, no filtering is applied. Separate multiple resource category IDs with commas (,).

parameters.name: ResourceOwnerIds
parameters.description: The list of resource owner IDs, used in cross-account unified management. Filters the computation results by the specified accounts. If this parameter is not specified, data for the current logon account is returned.
